result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers swap in real, clearly named buttons, move focus and update the title on each view change, give the price images alt text, and pad the page so the fixed bar can't cover focused items. B has a better live announcement, and A changes the look a little by hiding the green bar outside Browse. A wins because its Place order never claims success without an order endpoint, while B tells members 'Your order has been placed' even though nothing is sent, so orders would be silently lost at launch. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers replace the divs with properly named buttons, move focus to each view's heading, update the page title, add alt text for the prices and pad the page for the fixed bar. A's live announcement names the item and the basket total, and it leaves the green bar exactly as it was. B hides the bar outside Browse, which changes the agreed look, and its per-span live regions announce a bare number. B's submit handling is safer because it never reports a false success, but A clearly says its order isn't sent yet.
